During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3962 BBY]], a '''battle''' took place in the [[Gizer system/Legends|Gizer system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]]. The conflict erupted when [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] invaded [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces were engaged in a campaign known as [[Mandalorian Triumph]], that took them from their territory [[Battle of Contruum|through]]<ref name="Atlas" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]]<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and to the Gizer [[Star system/Legends|system]] on their way to conquer the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. After winning the battle in the Gizer system, the Mandalorians continued on and [[Battle of the Nazzri system (Mandalorian Wars)|fought for]] the [[Nazzri system/Legends|Nazzri system]], before proceeding further Coreward.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Gizer system was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Atlas" />
